description: This file defines a Java interface named ConnectivityQueryCommand, which extends another interface ConnectivityCommand. It specifies a contract for querying the state of a Connection object within the Eclipse Ditto framework, including a method for setting headers.

classes.name: ConnectivityQueryCommand
classes.description: An interface for commands that query the state of a Connection object, extending the base ConnectivityCommand interface.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command, returning the command instance for chaining.
